builds.name: Reference: Ultimate window
builds.goal: Reference for Fiddlesticks: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: An ambush mage who uses vision denial and fear to create time for channels. Completing W and keeping enemies in Crowstorm matter more than ordinary attack output. Measure uninterrupted W channels and enemies staying inside Crowstorm. Fear depends on actual vision state; spell damage cannot assume an unseen five-person ambush every time. Mana and ultimate-oriented item effects test repeated impactful R windows.
builds.summary: Mana and ultimate-oriented item effects test repeated impactful R windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Fiddlesticks: Measure uninterrupted W channels and enemies staying inside Crowstorm. Fear depends on actual vision state; spell damage cannot assume an unseen five-person ambush every time.

Start with the early core (Malignance only if the R interaction is confirmed, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Mana and ultimate-oriented item effects test repeated impactful R windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Fiddlesticks damaging enemies with spells while unseen or targeting an enemy with Terrify's activation strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration. kitEvidence.formula: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by Scarecrow Effigies. When discovered by enemies, Effigies briefly impersonate Fiddlesticks. If Fiddlesticks does not move for 2 seconds, he will impersonate an Effigy. At level six Effigies reveal nearby wards for 6 seconds.

Fiddlesticks channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus [12 / 14.5 / 17 / 19.5 / 22]% missing Health magic damage at the end. Fiddlesticks restores [25 / 32.5 / 40 / 47.5 / 55]% of damage as Health.

If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the remaining Cooldown is reduced by 60%.

Passive: While unseen and out of combat or impersonating an Effigy, damaging an enemy with an ability Fears them for [1.2 / 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 / 2] second(s).

Active: Fear an enemy for [1.2 / 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 / 2] second(s) and deal [0.04 / 0.045 / 0.05 / 0.055 / 0.06 + (0.0003) × AP] current Health magic damage. If the target has recently been Feared by Fiddlesticks, instead deal [(0.04 / 0.045 / 0.05 / 0.055 / 0.06 + (0.0003) × AP) × (2)] current Health magic damage.
Fiddlesticks channels for [1.5] seconds, then teleports and unleashes a murder of crows, dealing [(150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP) × (5)] magic damage over [5] seconds.

Fiddlesticks unleashes dark magic, dealing [70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [(-0.3 / -0.35 / -0.4 / -0.45 / -0.5) × -100]% for [1.25] seconds. Enemies in the center are also Silenced for the duration.
